name: Polynoxious
body:
Your poison is unusually varied for a member of your race.

Prerequisite(s): Racial poison ability that deals ability score damage

Benefit(s): When you take this feat, select an ability score that your poison does not primarily target but it in the same category of mental/physical ability scores (so if your poison normally deals constitution damage, you could select strength but not intelligence). By spending a standard action, you can change the makeup of your poison so that it deals damage to the ability score you selected when you took this feat. You can return your poison to normal with another standard action.

Special: If you have more than one natural poison, you must pick one poison to which this feat applies when you take the feat. You may take this feat multiple times, each time its effects apply to a different natural poison.
